subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential/scope/config contract should become the permanent boundary?
rationale: The remaining request changes credential storage, consent/scopes, access to non-mentioned Space content, subscription lifecycle, and fallback behavior; source review proves the gap but cannot choose that product and security contract.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account/mention-triggered and treat all-message ingestion as out of scope while finishing thread-reply reliability separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold this until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent combination of Google Chat code history and prior review context for the related OAuth/security boundary.
